reviews.claim_text: Opening a news-and-prayer recap, he points viewers back to the previous day's prayer video and says the Lord was showing them about the World War, without restating any content of it here.
reviews.note: Opening back-reference to the previous day's prayer video; carries no forecast of its own.

reviews.claim_text: Witchcraft is being worked around the Pergamon altar using a satanic artifact tied to CERN, and he sees darkness over CERN with black-cloaked men around it.
reviews.note: Adds a satanic artifact and black-cloaked men to the Berlin altar thread, and names CERN as the tie.

reviews.claim_text: Men in black cloaks are attempting to summon the Hitler spirit again, and he sees swastikas coming up out of Berlin.
reviews.note: Same summoning event; the new element is swastikas seen rising out of Berlin.

reviews.claim_text: He sees a woman the Lord names Ursula rising up over Europe.
reviews.note: Names her again over Europe with nothing added beyond the earlier tellings.

reviews.claim_text: The woman named Ursula has a bright star above her head and chains running from her into each of the nations; the Lord calls her a bride of Satan connected to the devil.
reviews.note: New imagery: the star, chains into each nation, and the title bride of Satan rather than head of the witches.

reviews.claim_text: Demonic worship and Satanism are being brought up through a man he names as George, alongside other wealthy cloaked figures.
reviews.note: Same recurring George in Europe; the delta is the Satanism attribution rather than political influence.

reviews.claim_text: These figures are working to draw England, France, Germany and Italy into a great war.
reviews.note: Same four-nation list as the earlier telling, but the driver named here is the occult figures rather than the economies.

reviews.claim_text: Turkey shuts the strait into the Black Sea while England and France try to bring battleships and major naval power in during the days ahead.
reviews.note: Names who is blocked: English and French battleships seeking entry, rather than commercial shipping.

reviews.claim_text: Turkey and Syria stand on Russia's side and block things, which he describes as causing a kink in the hose.
reviews.note: Adds that the pairing sides with Russia and physically blocks, borrowing the kink in the hose phrase from the BRICS oil thread.

reviews.claim_text: He sees the American president cracking a whip against this, shown as a balloon marked with his campaign slogan.
reviews.note: The whip-cracking image again, now over the Black Sea rather than over Russia.

reviews.claim_text: Praying, he sees two ways: one leading to World War III and a great war.
reviews.note: One of two paths named in the same breath; recorded as a branch so it is not scored as an unconditional forecast.

reviews.claim_text: The second of the two ways he sees is lavender fields with Russia.
reviews.note: The other path. The pair is the claim; neither half alone can be counted a hit.

reviews.claim_text: The lavender fields he sees are planted and giving a season.
reviews.note: Adds that the lavender is planted and giving a season, which is the closest thing to a horizon he puts on the peace path.

reviews.claim_text: The Lord tells him to watch China, which is quiet and playing chess while getting ready to do something he calls dangerous.
reviews.note: First telling of this watch-China word in the corpus.

reviews.claim_text: European nations under demonic influence are working through the Pergamon altar, CERN and the woman Ursula to bring about a single world-wide war.
reviews.note: Repeats the altar, CERN and Ursula combination from earlier in the same video.

reviews.claim_text: Europe is working to provoke a great war and to poke the bear, and he sees an attack coming on Poland again.
reviews.note: The word again marks this as a repeat attack rather than the first, which is new against the earlier telling.

reviews.claim_text: The Lord tells him a major earthquake is coming in Acapulco, San Francisco, Portland and those areas, and to watch the ring of fire.
reviews.note: Names three specific ring-of-fire cities, which the earlier swarm telling did not.

reviews.claim_text: A great disruption in Mexican politics follows once these things start, with chaos, and then a glory moving in on Mexico.
reviews.note: Ties the Mexican upheaval to the European events as a trigger, and pairs the chaos with a glory moving in.

reviews.claim_text: He sees a triangle running from the woman Ursula to Benjamin to Saudi Arabia, and a circuit from Europe to the Pergamon altar to Benjamin to Israel to Saudi Arabia and back to Europe, tied to bringing about the end of the end.
reviews.note: The same three-way alignment, now with the European vertex named as Ursula and the circuit routed through the Pergamon altar.

reviews.claim_text: Confirming a recap of what he saw, he names Claudia, an overthrowing of things, civil unrest, riots in the streets and people pillaging.
reviews.note: Adds rioting and pillaging around the removal. Read back to him by another speaker and confirmed, not spoken cold.

reviews.claim_text: He sees a great shaking in Canada.
reviews.note: Bare repeat of the Canadian shaking with no new content.

reviews.claim_text: He says the Lord will deal with an epidemic of cancer on the land which he attributes to the foods, that there are special anointings for cancer, and that a cure is coming for certain cancers.
reviews.note: Names the foods as the cause and narrows the cure to certain cancers rather than cancer generally.

reviews.claim_text: He sees a shaking of the auto industry in Detroit naming GM, calling it a major shaking of Motor City and one more round of shaking, spoken alongside a garbled remark about blue election outcomes.
reviews.note: First telling of a Detroit auto shaking as its own event. Kept apart from the earlier car industry bailout claim, which names a different mechanism.

reviews.claim_text: He sees Iran's leadership going down, and a reclusiveness coming over the Prince of Persia.
reviews.note: First telling in this video of the Iranian leadership going down; the named Ayatollah follows at 836.

reviews.claim_text: The Lord says he is giving the people of Iran a window and that the Prince of Persia will be reclusive for a season, which he says is short and guesses at three to five months or possibly a year.
reviews.note: First telling. Kept separate from the Prince of Persia latching onto Babylon claim, which describes the opposite movement.

reviews.claim_text: He sees a season of hot spots of revival breaking out in Iran, Pakistan and those areas.
reviews.note: Adds Pakistan and the hot-spot framing to the standing Iran revival thread.

reviews.claim_text: Revival will spring up in hot spots rather than everywhere, in Iran and with much persecution.
reviews.note: Qualifies the revival downward: spots rather than everywhere, and persecution alongside it.

reviews.claim_text: He sees the Ayatollah, the man in the black outfit rather than the white one, being taken out and says he is done, along with much of Iran's upper leadership, who will be replaced by a group that is not so radicalised.
reviews.note: Names the figure and adds the successor group described as less radicalised.
